headline: Bliss GVS Pharma Limited: Updates
sum: Updates — Bliss GVS Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'the intimation of recommendations by the Committee of Independent Directors pursuant to Regulation 26(7) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers)…
detail: Updates — Bliss GVS Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'the intimation of recommendations by the Committee of Independent Directors pursuant to Regulation 26(7) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 on Open Offer made by the Anupam Rasayan India Limited together with PAC to the Public Shareholders of the Bliss GVS Pharma Limited.'
